column1: # Wild STEP+STL pairs harvested from GitHub (Phase 0.5b).
# Model files are gitignored; this manifest is the record, and
# url + sha256 are what make a deleted pair recoverable.
# facets_per_90: facets spanning a quarter turn of curvature.
# smooth_pct: share of interior edges under 20 deg.
# Below ~20 facets/90deg a mesh is weak test material however
# well it verifies -- passing then means having little to get
# wrong. Do not quote a pass rate over the coarse rows.
# A url pinned to a commit sha instead of a branch is deliberate: the two White-Knight
# STLs so pinned are the direct Fusion exports from before the upstream commit
# "Updated STL file orientation", which re-saved every STL in that repo.
